title: fix: unify model description display
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Uses the shared model-name tooltip for agent descriptions
- Removes the agent-only inline description row
- Keeps catalog model and agent rows consistent

Follow-up to #13442

gist.headline: One tooltip to rule them
gist.blurb: The model catalog and agent list now tell the same story. Polli removed a spare description row before it could grow roots.
gist.summary: Agent model rows now use the shared model-name tooltip and no longer render their separate inline description row, matching the catalog display.
gist.impact: Users get a consistent model-description experience across catalog and agent rows, with details available through the same tooltip behavior.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny librarian wearing round reading glasses, tidying two matching model cards beside a cozy retro terminal. One shared tooltip floats above both cards while small code-plants and flowers make the interface feel like an orderly garden.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown stripes, pink rectangular cheek blush, light blue wings, and tiny round librarian glasses, aligning two matching model cards beside a glowing retro terminal; one neat shared tooltip hovers above them while code-plants grow in lime green (#ecf874) pots. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with subtle pixel-font text: "SAME DETAILS".
